basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old avid gamer and tech enthusiast based in Ann Arbor, Michigan. I work as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company, specializing in mobile app development. My interests include playing mobile games like Idle Heroes, traveling whenever possible, and staying updated on tech trends. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work, and sometimes during lunch breaks. I'm currently single and enjoy meeting new people through gaming and tech forums.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Michigan. My expertise in technology and gaming comes from both my professional work and personal interests. I constantly explore new tech developments and gaming strategies through online courses and forums.
